v8.hero.lede.zh: 广州南风站阿里中心视野开阔，是欣赏落日的理想打卡点。
v8.hero.lede.en: With its expansive views, Alibaba Center · Nanfeng Station in Guangzhou is a perfect place to catch the sunset.

v8.hero.s2Lede.zh: 五仙观 —— 一座明朝时期的道观，供奉着五位仙人的传说以及广州“羊城”之称的由来。
v8.hero.s2Lede.en: Wuxian Taoist Temple (Wuxian Guan) — A Ming-dynasty Taoist temple honoring the legend of the Five Immortals and the origin of Guangzhou’s “Ram City” name.
